chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in urinating in flowing water.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; indicates permissibility in this legal context

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to urinate in flowing water according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling that urinating in flowing water is not considered problematic. It pertains to rulings of ritual purity and practical jurisprudence regarding water.
